project.title: The Constitutional Internet
project.subtitle: The Last Human Frontier
project.purpose: Reconcile manuscript claims against canonical doctrine, external evidence, actual code, tests, receipts, demonstrations, and deployment state.

auditInvariant: Documentation may describe intent; only code, tests, receipts, and current deployment evidence establish implementation state.

implementationStates.Ratified: Constitutional rule formally adopted; cite ratification record and section.
implementationStates.Implemented: Code or configuration exists; cite exact path and commit.
implementationStates.Operational: Capability is running in an environment used by intended participants; cite environment and evidence.
implementationStates.Demonstrated: Capability has been exercised successfully in a bounded demo or test; cite receipt/test/result.
implementationStates.Entering deployment: Implementation exists and deployment work is active but operation is not yet established.
implementationStates.Experimental: Research or prototype capability under test; do not present as production.
implementationStates.Projected: Future design or intended capability without implemented evidence.

evidenceTypes.Doctrine: Polity Paper, ratified rule, constitutional commentary, canonical definition.
evidenceTypes.Code: Exact repo path, symbol/component, schema, migration, contract, route or service.
evidenceTypes.Test: Automated or manual test proving expected behavior and constitutional boundary.
evidenceTypes.Receipt: Immutable or inspectable record of an actual action, refusal, state change or proof.
evidenceTypes.External: Primary legal, historical, scientific, technical or institutional source.

discrepancyTypes.Overclaim: Manuscript states more than code/evidence supports.
discrepancyTypes.Underclaim: Capability is more mature than manuscript wording indicates.
discrepancyTypes.Ontology conflict: Names, roles, relationships or definitions differ from current canon.
discrepancyTypes.Superseded evidence: Artifact describes an older architecture or status.
discrepancyTypes.Missing proof: Code exists but no adequate test, receipt or operational demonstration was found.
